title: Shukukramatrka Vati
description: Shukukramatrka Vati (Shukramatrika Vati) is a complex formulation targeting sperm conservation and lower urinary tract health in men. This classical tablet cures spermatorrhea (involuntary sperm loss) occurring without sexual stimulation, indicating weak reproductive system tone. Nocturnal emissions (wet dreams) are prevented through improved control mechanisms and tissue strengthening. Strengthens weak urinary sphincters that allow involuntary urine leakage, addressing both reproductive and urinary incontinence. The goat's milk dosage provides additional nourishing properties.
dosage: 1–2 tablets twice daily with goat's milk or water
